details.s: Meriadoc "Merry" Brandybuck was a Hobbit of the Shire and one of Frodo Baggins cousins and closest friends. He loved boats and ponies and had a great interest in the maps of Middle-earth. He was also one of the nine companions of the The Fellowship of the Ring, and later became the eighth Master of Buckland.
f: Master of Buckland, Knight of Rohan
